name: Walrus
subject_description: A real subadult Atlantic walrus (Odobenus rosmarus): about 2.0-2.3 m long, several hundred kg, grey-brown wrinkled thick skin with sparse short hair, a rounded blunt snout with a dense pad of stiff pale whisker bristles, small eyes, no external ears, small tusks just emerging a few centimeters (NOT long curved adult tusks), a thick rolled neck, large front flippers used for dragging/pushing its body, small rear flippers. Damp skin, as if recently among ice.
anatomy_notes: Two large front flippers used to drag and push the body, two smaller rear flippers. A rounded blunt snout with a dense pad of stiff pale whisker bristles. Small tusks just emerging, a few centimeters long, NOT the long curved tusks of a full adult. No external ears. About 2.0-2.3 m long, several hundred kg, grey-brown wrinkled skin.

extra_panels.title: Waddling / heaving gait
extra_panels.description: the walrus captured mid-motion in its rolling, heaving waddle across a hard flat surface, front flippers braced and pushing, body undulating

extra_panels.title: Burping / mouth open
extra_panels.description: a close-up of the walrus's head with its mouth open mid-burp, whisker pad clearly visible
